NEHA GUPTA

Location: Bengaluru | Phone: 9986135822 | Email: nehajgupta2207@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Payments and Financial Operations Specialist with 9+ years of experience in investment banking and capital markets. Proven expertise in SWIFT payments (MT103, MT202, MT202COV), trade settlements, reconciliations, and cash flow management. Hands-on exposure to major financial platforms (Murex, DTCC, MarkitWire, Plasma, Arpe, OSP, Datamart, CME, ICE). Demonstrated capability in working with global clearing systems and payment investigations. Adept in stakeholder coordination, project execution, and streamlining payment operations across geographies.

SKILLS & CORE COMPETENCIES

Trade Management & Settlements • Risk Management & Compliance • Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Management • Process Improvement & Automation • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills • Regulatory Compliance & Operational Controls • Client Service Excellence • Strong Organizational & Communication Skills • Payments & Messaging Standards: SWIFT MT (103, 202, 202COV) • Knowledge of ISO 20022 • Platforms & Tools: Murex, Plasma, MarkitWire, DTCC, Arpe

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

SME at TerraPay | June 2025 to till date

Updated and standardized SOPs, ensuring consistency and compliance across processes. • Designed factsheets and dashboards to support management reporting. • Collaborated with internal teams (Ops, Compliance, Tech, Product) and external partners (banks, clients, payment networks).

Onboarded new clients, ensuring smooth integration and compliance readiness. • Detected and escalated potential fraud risks, preventing financial/reputational damage. • Trained team members on updated processes and compliance standards. • Resolved escalated issues by liaising with cross‑functional teams and partners. • Prepared daily EOD reports for management review. • Communicated outage/downtime notifications to stakeholders for transparency. • Implemented process optimization initiatives, increasing efficiency by 15%.

Associate Consultant - Aeries Technologies, Bengaluru | Jul 2024 – Apr 2025

Automated and designed financial reporting templates using Adobe InDesign, improving reporting efficiency by ~20%

and reducing manual preparation time.

Senior Associate – BNP Paribas India Solutions, Bengaluru | Apr 2021 – Nov 2022

Executed manual and SWIFT-based payments (MT103/202/202COV) for IRS and CDS trades. • Managed payment routing using Plasma and Arpe systems; ensured compliance with settlement timelines. • Generated reports to monitor daily payment flows and exceptions. • Collaborated with global teams on clearing and settlement across CHIPS and FEDS platforms. Senior Analyst – ANZ, Bengaluru | Feb 2020 – Mar 2021

Supported Fixed Income and Commodities operations, validating trades and reconciling positions. • Ensured accuracy of SWIFT messages and trade bookings aligned with internal records. • Conducted end-of-day reconciliation and issue resolution with external custodians.

Analyst – Thomson Reuters, Bengaluru | Feb 2016 – May 2018

Handled daily cash reconciliation and payment discrepancy investigations. • Prepared reports for audit readiness and implemented process improvements in cash ops. • Engaged in cross-border payments and collaborated on payment investigation resolution.

Associate – GlobeOp Financial Services, Mumbai | 2014 – 2015

Processed wire transfers for client accounts, margin calls, and liquidity events. • Supported trade and cash reconciliation and resolved message mismatches. • Coordinated with custodians and internal teams for timely processing of payments. • Setup of SSIs and other important static data for client on the in-house GlobeOp application. Trainee – Morgan Stanley Advantage Services, Mumbai | 2013 – 2014

Assisted in fund pricing, reconciliations, and data validations for hedge fund clients. • Used Investran and Excel-based tools for daily operational reporting.

Education

Master of Management Studies (Finance) – Thakur Institute of Management Studies & Research, Mumbai University |

2011–2013 | 68%

Bachelor of Management Studies (Finance) – Royal College, Mumbai University | 2007–2010 | 62% • Higher Secondary Certificate (Commerce) – Raval College, Maharashtra Board | 2005–2007 | 71% • Secondary School Certificate – K.P.E.S. School, Gujarat Board | 2005 | 67%

OTHER COURSES & CERTIFICATIONS

Financial Modelling from Consci Consultancy Pvt. Ltd. • NSE Certification in Financial Markets [NCFM] - Capital & Derivatives Markets Module
